state: Two eight-nibble halves L^r[0..7] and R^r[0..7]. All entries are hexadecimal nibbles.
round_keys: K^0,...,K^3 are arbitrary independent eight-nibble round keys. They are fixed when evaluating one conditional trail probability.
equivalent_first_lane_recurrence: For r=0,1: x^(r+2)_i = S_{pi[i]}(x^(r+1)_{pi[i]}) xor x^r_{(i+6) mod 8} xor K^r_{(i+6) mod 8} xor K^(r+2)_i.
hex_string_indexing: The rightmost hexadecimal character is cell 0 and the leftmost character is cell 7. Thus 00040000 has delta_x[4]=4. Parse each listed string with list(reversed(hex_string)) when constructing arrays indexed 0..7.
trail_event: For every r and i, require S_i(x^r_i) xor S_i(x^r_i xor delta_x^r_i) = delta_y^r_i. The listed difference rows satisfy the Feistel round linkage.
probability_space: For a fixed tuple (K^0,K^1,K^2,K^3), x^0 and x^1 range independently and uniformly over all 16^16 nibble assignments. The recurrence determines x^2 and x^3. P_K is the exact fraction of these assignments satisfying the complete trail_event.
key_distribution: The requested key fractions are over all uniformly distributed independent tuples (K^0,K^1,K^2,K^3). An equivalent quotient projection may be used instead of enumerating the full 2^128 key space.
markov_definition: The local Markov estimate is the product, over all active cells, of DDT_i[delta_x][delta_y]/16. Its weight is -log2 of that product.
